qcExceptions.reason: art_review silhouette-collision vs enemy-lanternmonk-move at 0.041 is a low-occupancy artefact of two small-in-cell subjects: measured bbox w/h 2.50 (flat leg-star, 73 px tall) vs 1.18 (upright hooded pear with hanging lantern, 98 px tall); visually unmistakable at 48-120 px.

art_review silhouette-collision vs canon enemy-paleknight-move at 0.041: both are upright bipeds, but the revenant is pale parchment (L* p75 71.3, trailing bandage strips) against the knight's cold dark steel (L* p75 40.8) - value, hue and trailing strips separate them; desert-only vs shared roster.

4-frame pendulum loop reuses the straight-hang drawing for frames 1 and 3 (generation of a distinct second straight pose failed provider-side); the original cadaver base frame was dropped because every edit re-rendered the wight as a skeletal hanged corpse, which is the identity all 3 gibbet sheets now share.
